response.text: The doc says a journal's SRC_REF is the user's name, but the data shows invoice numbers and payment IDs. I'll check that along with the integrity checks.

arguments.sql: SELECT "SRC_CD", left("SRC_REF",4) p, count(*), min("SRC_REF"), max("SRC_REF") FROM "GLJRNH" GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2 LIMIT 40
SELECT * FROM "GLJRNH" WHERE "SRC_CD"='GL' OR "REF_JRNL_NO" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY "JRNL_NO" LIMIT 25

SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT "JRNL_NO" FROM "GLJRNL" GROUP BY 1 HAVING sum("DR_AMT")<>sum("CR_AMT")) x) unbalanced, (SELECT count(*) FROM "GLJRNL" l WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "GLJRNH" h WHERE h."JRNL_NO"=l."JRNL_NO")) orphan_lines, (SELECT count(*) FROM "GLJRNH" h WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "GLJRNL" l WHERE h."JRNL_NO"=l."JRNL_NO")) hdr_nolines, (SELECT count(*) FROM "GLJRNL" l WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "GLCOA" c WHERE c."ACCT_CD"=l."ACCT_CD")) bad_acct, (SELECT count(*) FROM "GLJRNL" WHERE "DR_AMT"<0 OR "CR_AMT"<0) neg_lines, (SELECT count(*) FROM "GLJRNL" WHERE "DR_AMT" IS NULL OR "CR_AMT" IS NULL) null_amt, (SELECT count(*) FROM "GLJRNL" WHERE "DR_AMT"<>0 AND "CR_AMT"<>0) both_sides, (SELECT count(*) FROM "APINVH" i WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "APVEND" v WHERE v."VEND_CD"=i."VEND_CD")) inv_bad_vend, (SELECT count(*) FROM "APINVH" i WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "GLJRNH" h WHERE h."JRNL_NO"=i."JRNL_NO")) inv_bad_jrnl, (SELECT count(*) FROM "APPAYM" p WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "APINVH" i WHERE i."INV_ID"=p."INV_ID")) pay_bad_inv, (SELECT count(*) FROM "GLJRNH" h WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "GLPERD" p WHERE p."PRD_ID"=h."PRD_ID")) jh_bad_prd

SELECT count(*) total, count(DISTINCT "INV_ID") d_inv, sum(CASE WHEN "STAT_CD"='P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) paid, min("INV_DT"), max("INV_DT"), min("INV_AMT"), max("INV_AMT"), sum(CASE WHEN "INV_AMT"<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nonpos, count(DISTINCT "JRNL_NO") dj FROM "APINVH"
